milestone: M2.7 GPU08 local DeepSeek serving smoke
outcome: PASS for one bounded local inference request after two preserved failed startup attempts

model.checkpoint_audit: 64/64 files matched, including 48/48 safetensors; issue list empty in the private integrity record

attempts.outcome: Weight shards were read, then the loader stopped at the FP8 wo_a dequantization stage. RSS reached 164,334,024 KiB; GPU utilization was 0% at the recorded sample. No health response or inference request.
SGLang reported application startup after loading 48/48 shards. The first scheduler request failed while reading Triton JIT metadata with JSONDecodeError; no complete inference response.
With the FP8 wo_a toggle and isolated cache, all 48 shards loaded, the server became healthy, and one local inference request passed the frozen JSON acceptance check.

interpretation.observed: A single local DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 request completed on GPU08 using eight allocated H20 GPUs.
interpretation.inference: The v1 stall resembles an upstream-reported SGLang FP8 wo_a host-materialization problem; v2's cache parse failure was avoided by a job-specific Triton cache. These matches guide diagnosis but do not prove identical root causes.
interpretation.not_tested: No mathematical problem, proof, population, batch request, concurrency, throughput benchmark, or organization comparison was run.

readiness.10k_population: not launched; this milestone does not establish its readiness
